notes.title: SNS and Game Streaming Guidelines
notes.content:
We warmly welcome SNS posts and game streaming of BatteryNote from those who have reviewed the following guidelines!

SNS and Game Streaming Guidelines

1. Please include the following information in your video description or post:
[code]BatteryNote
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3005930/BatteryNote/
©72studio / room6
#BatteryNote
[/code]
2. The following actions are prohibited:

Content that severely damages the game’s image.
Use in overtly sexual content or content that violates public order and morality.
3. Please be mindful of spoilers, especially regarding key story elements, and add spoiler warnings when necessary.

4. If requested by 72studio / room6, please promptly take down any videos or articles.

5. 72studio / room6 makes no guarantees regarding the publication or distribution of videos or articles. We will not compensate for any damages or disputes with third parties arising from the use of this game.

Streaming Assets
Download them from the link below and use them for your streams:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/153wzifHu2Jxi41hiGk5Rnyj0UHoFkVZ8

Please refrain from using these assets for fan creations, derivative works, or doujin activities. These materials are for backup use in streaming only.

Official Hashtag for SNS
Please use #BatteryNote.

We’re looking forward to seeing all your wonderful streams and content!

notes.title: We’ve upgraded the demo!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/881d79606909d8de99f1622e191a352d1cf65634.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/382098e99bf14ca2d6985580486fe72e05a25756.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/830450175bfa5fe12d879768c64a9dcdfcb1b8b6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042155/9dc26aff749d9f5c22f73585520cdc92e53c6282.png

We’ve upgraded the demo! Feel free to give it a try!  
We’re now diving into full scenario implementation, so please look forward to the official release!

Changes  
  
 Updated visuals!  
 Slightly expanded opening scene!  
 The feel of pressing the high-voltage switch has changed! (You’ll have to play to see how!)  


Currently, we are only offering the Japanese version, but we plan to provide an English version in the future. Please stay tuned!
